title: Cosmic Pregnancy Portal
description: A pregnant woman with long flowing purple and black hair dances gracefully in a mystical forest, wearing a jeweled bra and flowing pink ribbons. Behind her is a large ornate oval portal revealing a vibrant galaxy and stars, flanked by ancient carved pillars and glowing crystals under a starry night sky with pink cherry blossoms.
